problem.title: Oilfield operations often depend on incomplete field information.
problem.description: Mature oilfields carry decades of operational history. Buried pipelines, abandoned metallic infrastructure, undocumented crossings, casing remnants, and out-of-service assets may remain underground long after original records become outdated or incomplete.
items: Accidental damage to buried pipelines or metallic infrastructure
Delays caused by unexpected underground obstructions
Cost overruns from incomplete field documentation
Higher risk during well pad expansion, trenching, or civil works

metadata.title: StrataIntel | Aerial Magnetometry
metadata.description: Aerial magnetometry for buried infrastructure detection. Identify buried pipelines, metallic debris, and undocumented subsurface assets before excavation or construction.
metadata.keywords: aerial magnetometry, buried pipeline detection, subsurface detection, magnetic anomaly detection, ferromagnetic detection, buried infrastructure, oilfield magnetometry

hero.title: Aerial Magnetometry for Buried Infrastructure
hero.description: See what's beneath the surface before breaking ground. Our drone-mounted magnetometry detects buried pipelines, metallic debris, and undocumented infrastructure in complex oilfield environments.

flagship.howItWorksDescription: Our system measures subtle variations in Earth's magnetic field caused by ferromagnetic materials underground.

howItWorksSteps.title: High-Sensitivity Sensors
howItWorksSteps.body: Industrial-grade magnetometers detect magnetic field variations with precision, mounted on stable drone platforms.

howItWorksSteps.title: Systematic Coverage
howItWorksSteps.body: Planned flight paths ensure complete area coverage with consistent altitude and spacing for reliable data collection.

howItWorksSteps.title: Expert Processing
howItWorksSteps.body: Raw magnetic data is processed and interpreted into actionable anomaly maps showing potential buried infrastructure.

flagship.whyDescription: Traditional ground surveys are slow and limited. Aerial magnetometry covers large areas quickly while maintaining precision.

advantages.title: Rapid Area Coverage
advantages.body: Survey large field areas in hours instead of days. Aerial platforms move faster than ground crews while maintaining data quality.
details: Cover 50+ hectares per day depending on terrain and mission parameters
No need to access difficult or hazardous ground areas

advantages.title: Non-Invasive Detection
advantages.body: Identify buried infrastructure without excavation, drilling, or ground penetration. No disruption to active operations.
details: Detect buried metallic objects through soil, vegetation, and surface layers
Safe for active field sites and sensitive environments

advantages.title: Better Pre-Work Intelligence
advantages.body: Give your team and contractors clearer field visibility before excavation, construction, or maintenance begins.
details: Reduce accidental strikes and costly project delays
Improve contractor bidding accuracy with better subsurface information

advantages.title: Mature Field Expertise
advantages.body: Designed for complex oilfield environments where decades of operations create buried infrastructure layers.
details: Effective where records are incomplete or outdated
Built for heavy-crude operations and rehabilitation zones

flagship.ctaDescription: Let's discuss whether aerial magnetometry can help reduce subsurface uncertainty for your next field intervention.
flagship.title: Flagship Capability: Aerial Magnetometry for Buried Infrastructure Detection
flagship.description: Aerial magnetometry uses a high-sensitivity magnetometer mounted on an industrial drone platform to measure variations in the Earth's magnetic field. These variations can reveal the presence of buried ferromagnetic objects such as pipelines, metallic debris, abandoned infrastructure, casing remnants, and other undocumented subsurface assets.
flagship.outputNote: The exact deliverable format depends on project scope, sensor configuration, processing requirements, and client needs. Final output formats should be defined during the technical scoping phase.
detects: Buried pipelines and metallic line segments
Casing remnants and well-related metallic assets
Potential conflict zones before excavation or construction
outputs: Risk or priority zones for further review
